aboutPage.title: Built around one job: finding the right part for your car
aboutPage.description: Dakar Auto exists to make sourcing genuine auto parts simple. Enter your VIN, tell us what you need, and our team takes it from there — no account, no guesswork, no back-and-forth with mismatched listings.
aboutPage.missionBody: We connect drivers with the exact part their vehicle needs, and with complete vehicles sourced from trusted markets abroad. Every request starts with your vehicle's real specs, decoded from its VIN, so the parts and vehicles we source actually fit.
aboutPage.ctaDescription: Identify your vehicle and send your first request in minutes.
